resources.string: Tap Start, then speak. Each spoken turn is sent to this text chat. The phone reads the new completed reply, then listens again. Stop, leaving, locking or disconnecting ends voice, not the agent’s work. Voice never queues or retries a prompt. Keep the message box empty.
Microphone allowed. Tap Start or hold again to begin.
Allow microphone access in Settings → Apps → Nekko Agent → Permissions, then start again.
This phone needs installed on-device speech recognition (Android 12 or later). No cloud speech fallback is used.
